title: Jabra Evolve 20 repair kit
author: user_2973466422
description:
Here is small kit to fix your broken Jabra Evolve 20.

You need to drill broken hard phone with 4 mm drill bit to enlarge hole.

I also suggest to use super glue to fix stopping ring.

A bit of soldering is also requires to solder back 2 wires.

jabra evolve 20 broken headphone repair kit broken

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
